title: Reflection identity for stop loss
statement:
For every natural number $n$ and every real number $t$, let $R_n$ be the normalized sum of the $n$ coordinates of a uniformly chosen sign vector, namely $R_n(x)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ (with the coefficient interpreted as zero when $n=0$). Then
\[
\mathbb E_x[(R_n(x)-t)^+]=-t+\mathbb E_x[(R_n(x)+t)^+],
\]
where $z^+=\max(z,0)$ and the averages are uniform over the sign cube.
